name: unsloth-byok
description: Zero-touch dynamic language model provider for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Models are discovered live from /v1/models — no manual list maintenance.

unslothByok.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (should end with /v1). Models are fetched from <baseUrl>/models.

unslothByok.apiKey.markdownDescription: Plaintext fallback for the API key. Prefer the command **Unsloth BYOK: Set API Key**, which stores the key in VS Code secret storage.

unslothByok.maxInputTokens.description: Reported max input tokens for discovered models.

unslothByok.maxOutputTokens.description: Reported max output tokens for discovered models.

unslothByok.enableTools.description: Advertise tool-calling capability (needed for Copilot agent mode) and pass tools through to the endpoint.

unslothByok.injectWorkspaceContext.markdownDescription: Automatically inject workspace context (active files, git info, open tabs) into system prompts. Enables models to understand your project structure and provide more relevant responses.

unslothByok.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Enable verbose logging of tool calls, results, and workspace context. Check the **Unsloth BYOK** output channel for details.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, ending with /v1.

commands.title: Unsloth BYOK: Show Workspace Context
commands.description: Display the workspace context that will be injected into model prompts.
